name: 3ds Max
summaryEn: inspect scenes and automate modeling, materials, transforms, and render preparation
summaryZh: 检查场景，并自动化建模、材质、变换与渲染准备
tasksEn: inventory scene objects and modifiers
create and place editable geometry
verify materials, transforms, and render settings
tasksZh: 盘点场景对象与修改器
创建并摆放可编辑几何体
验证材质、变换与渲染设置

name: After Effects
summaryEn: inspect projects and automate compositions, layers, keyframes, effects, and previews
summaryZh: 检查项目，并自动化合成、图层、关键帧、特效与预览
tasksEn: inventory compositions and source footage
build a bounded motion-graphics treatment
validate frame range, missing media, and preview output
tasksZh: 盘点合成与源素材
制作范围明确的动态图形效果
验证帧范围、丢失媒体与预览输出

name: Blender
summaryEn: inspect live scenes and automate objects, modifiers, materials, animation, and rendering
summaryZh: 检查在线场景，并自动化对象、修改器、材质、动画与渲染
tasksEn: inspect collections, objects, and modifiers
create a nondestructive modeling change
validate object state and a preview render
tasksZh: 检查集合、对象与修改器
完成一次非破坏性建模修改
验证对象状态与预览渲染

name: Cinema 4D
summaryEn: inspect durable documents and automate typed primitives, transforms, interchange, and bounded renders
summaryZh: 检查持久化文档，并自动化类型化基础体、变换、格式交换与受控渲染
tasksEn: inspect documents, objects, materials, and runtime capabilities
create and transform allowlisted primitives in an atomic document update
validate the saved document, render, and supported interchange output
tasksZh: 检查文档、对象、材质与运行时能力
通过原子文档更新创建并变换白名单基础体
验证保存后的文档、渲染与受支持的交换格式输出

name: ComfyUI
summaryEn: validate API-format graphs against live node contracts, run bounded queue jobs, and retrieve artifacts
summaryZh: 依据实时节点契约验证 API 格式图，运行受控队列任务并取回产物
tasksEn: validate node classes, required inputs, and graph references
submit and wait for one bounded image workflow
query terminal status and retrieve a known output artifact
tasksZh: 验证节点类型、必需输入与图引用
提交并等待一个范围明确的图像工作流
查询终态并取回已知输出产物

name: Cache Inspector
summaryEn: inspect SideFX geo, bgeo, and bgeo.sc caches offline through bounded privacy-safe read-only projections
summaryZh: 离线检查 SideFX geo、bgeo 与 bgeo.sc 缓存，并返回有界、隐私安全的只读结构投影
tasksEn: detect cache format and decode within public size ceilings
inspect counts, primitive families, finite bounds, and attribute definitions
verify that raw geometry values and the free-form info block are absent
tasksZh: 识别缓存格式并在公共大小上限内解码
检查数量、图元家族、有限边界与属性定义
验证结果不包含原始几何值和自由格式 info 块

name: Flow Production Tracking
summaryEn: query production entities and safely update approved tasks, notes, versions, and status
summaryZh: 查询制片实体，并安全更新已获批准的任务、备注、版本与状态
tasksEn: find a project, shot, asset, or task
summarize linked notes and versions
preview and confirm any status-changing write
tasksZh: 查找项目、镜头、资产或任务
汇总关联备注与版本
预览并确认任何状态写入

name: FreeCAD
summaryEn: inspect parametric CAD documents and automate primitives, booleans, topology validation, and mesh interchange
summaryZh: 检查参数化 CAD 文档，并自动化基础体、布尔运算、拓扑验证与网格交换
tasksEn: inspect document objects, shapes, bounds, and physical properties
build an editable solid from typed primitives and booleans
validate topology and export a verified OBJ or STL
tasksZh: 检查文档对象、形体、边界与物理属性
通过类型化基础体与布尔运算构建可编辑实体
验证拓扑并导出经核验的 OBJ 或 STL

name: GIMP
summaryEn: inspect documents and automate layers, selections, masks, color work, and exports
summaryZh: 检查文档，并自动化图层、选区、蒙版、颜色处理与导出
tasksEn: inspect image dimensions and layer structure
apply a reversible retouching pass
export a copy without overwriting the source
tasksZh: 检查图像尺寸与图层结构
完成一次可撤销修图
导出副本且不覆盖源文件

name: Godot
summaryEn: inspect projects and automate scenes, nodes, resources, scripts, and playable validation
summaryZh: 检查项目，并自动化场景、节点、资源、脚本与可玩性验证
tasksEn: inventory scenes, nodes, and project settings
build one small playable interaction
run and verify the win or fail loop
tasksZh: 盘点场景、节点与项目设置
构建一个小型可玩交互
运行并验证胜负循环

name: Houdini
summaryEn: inspect node networks and automate procedural geometry, simulations, caches, and renders
summaryZh: 检查节点网络，并自动化程序化几何、模拟、缓存与渲染
tasksEn: inspect the current node graph and parameters
build a minimal procedural or simulation setup
validate scale, cache state, and preview output
tasksZh: 检查当前节点图与参数
构建最小程序化或模拟设置
验证比例、缓存状态与预览输出

name: Illustrator
summaryEn: inspect vector documents and automate artboards, layers, paths, text, saves, and production exports
summaryZh: 检查矢量文档，并自动化画板、图层、路径、文本、保存与生产导出
tasksEn: inspect documents, artboards, layers, and page items
create or edit typed rectangles, paths, and text through the official DOM
validate document state, save an AI copy, and export SVG or PNG
tasksZh: 检查文档、画板、图层与页面对象
通过官方 DOM 创建或编辑类型化矩形、路径与文本
验证文档状态、保存 AI 副本并导出 SVG 或 PNG

name: Katana
summaryEn: inspect node graphs and automate look development, lighting, scene assembly, and render setup
summaryZh: 检查节点图，并自动化外观开发、灯光、场景装配与渲染设置
tasksEn: inspect the scene graph and active node graph
apply a bounded look-development change
validate assignments and a test render
tasksZh: 检查场景图与当前节点图
完成一次范围明确的外观开发修改
验证分配关系与测试渲染

name: Krita
summaryEn: inspect documents and automate layers, selections, painting operations, and exports
summaryZh: 检查文档，并自动化图层、选区、绘画操作与导出
tasksEn: inspect canvas and layer state
make a reversible paint or adjustment pass
verify color space and export a copy
tasksZh: 检查画布与图层状态
完成一次可撤销绘画或调整
验证色彩空间并导出副本

name: Mari
summaryEn: inspect projects and automate geometry, channels, node graphs, shaders, images, and texture exports
summaryZh: 检查项目，并自动化几何体、通道、节点图、着色器、图像与纹理导出
tasksEn: inspect the active project, geometry, channels, nodes, shaders, and images
make a bounded typed change to geometry, channels, or the node graph
validate export items and the resulting texture files
tasksZh: 检查当前项目、几何体、通道、节点、着色器与图像
对几何体、通道或节点图完成一次范围明确的类型化修改
验证导出项与生成的纹理文件

name: Marmoset Toolbag
summaryEn: inspect scenes and automate PBR materials, lighting, baking, cameras, and presentation renders
summaryZh: 检查场景，并自动化 PBR 材质、灯光、烘焙、摄影机与展示渲染
tasksEn: inspect meshes, materials, and texture slots
build a controlled look-development pass
validate maps, lighting, and a turntable render
tasksZh: 检查网格、材质与贴图槽
完成一次受控外观开发
验证贴图、灯光与转台渲染

name: Material Maker
summaryEn: inspect and author procedural material graphs, parameters, and texture outputs
summaryZh: 检查并制作程序化材质图、参数与纹理输出
tasksEn: inspect graph nodes and exposed parameters
build one editable procedural material
verify seamless outputs and exported maps
tasksZh: 检查图节点与公开参数
构建一个可编辑程序化材质
验证无缝输出与导出贴图

name: Maya
summaryEn: inspect live scenes; AssetSync v2 editable rigs, animation, groom, materials, and Arnold lookdev require dcc-mcp-maya 0.9.26 or newer
summaryZh: 检查在线场景；AssetSync v2 的可编辑绑定、动画、毛发、材质与 Arnold 外观开发需要 dcc-mcp-maya 0.9.26 或更高版本
tasksEn: inspect DAG nodes and scene state before checking the installed Maya adapter version
preserve native joints, animation curves, groom curves, textures, and materials
validate controller and constraint editability plus bounded Arnold output
tasksZh: 检查 DAG 节点与场景状态，再核对已安装的 Maya 适配器版本
保留原生骨骼、动画曲线、毛发曲线、纹理与材质
验证控制器和约束的可编辑性，以及范围明确的 Arnold 输出
availabilityEn: Core 0.20.25 currently selects dcc-mcp-maya 0.9.22. Upgrade to dcc-mcp-maya 0.9.26 or newer before using the AssetSync v2 rig, groom, material, animation, and Arnold lookdev workflow merged in PR #486.
availabilityZh: Core 0.20.25 当前选择 dcc-mcp-maya 0.9.22。使用 PR #486 合并的 AssetSync v2 绑定、毛发、材质、动画与 Arnold 外观开发工作流前，请先升级到 dcc-mcp-maya 0.9.26 或更高版本。

name: MotionBuilder
summaryEn: inspect scenes and automate characters, takes, animation data, and motion-editing workflows
summaryZh: 检查场景，并自动化角色、Take、动画数据与动作编辑流程
tasksEn: inspect characters, takes, and active animation
apply a bounded motion-editing change
validate timing, character mapping, and saved output
tasksZh: 检查角色、Take 与当前动画
完成一次范围明确的动作编辑
验证时序、角色映射与保存结果

name: Nuke
summaryEn: inspect scripts and automate node-based compositing, color, channels, and renders
summaryZh: 检查脚本，并自动化节点式合成、色彩、通道与渲染
tasksEn: inspect the node graph and source metadata
build one reversible compositing branch
validate frame range, channels, color space, and preview
tasksZh: 检查节点图与源素材元数据
构建一个可撤销合成分支
验证帧范围、通道、色彩空间与预览

name: OpenUSD
summaryEn: inspect stages and automate layers, prims, composition arcs, metadata, and validation
summaryZh: 检查 Stage，并自动化 Layer、Prim、组合弧、元数据与验证
tasksEn: inspect stage layers and prim hierarchy
author a bounded non-destructive layer change
validate composition, references, and schema state
tasksZh: 检查 Stage Layer 与 Prim 层级
在独立 Layer 中完成范围明确的修改
验证组合、引用与 Schema 状态

name: OpenSCAD
summaryEn: inspect declarative CAD source and automate bounded validation, preview rendering, and mesh export
summaryZh: 检查声明式 CAD 源码，并自动化受控验证、预览渲染与网格导出
tasksEn: inspect source dependencies and runtime capabilities
validate one bounded parametric model without arbitrary code execution
render a preview and export a verified STL or mesh result
tasksZh: 检查源码依赖与运行时能力
在禁止任意代码执行的边界内验证参数化模型
渲染预览并导出经核验的 STL 或网格结果

name: Photoshop
summaryEn: inspect documents and automate layers, masks, adjustments, retouching, and exports
summaryZh: 检查文档，并自动化图层、蒙版、调整、修图与导出
tasksEn: inspect dimensions, color mode, and layers
make a reversible edit with layers or masks
export a new file without flattening the source
tasksZh: 检查尺寸、颜色模式与图层
使用图层或蒙版完成可撤销编辑
在不合并源文件的情况下导出新文件

name: PowerPoint
summaryEn: inspect presentations and automate slides, layouts, text, media, and review-deck output
summaryZh: 检查演示文稿，并自动化幻灯片、版式、文本、媒体与评审文稿输出
tasksEn: inventory slides, layouts, text, and linked media
create or revise one bounded slide sequence
validate slide order, visual output, and the saved copy
tasksZh: 盘点幻灯片、版式、文本与链接媒体
创建或修改一个范围明确的幻灯片序列
验证幻灯片顺序、视觉输出与保存副本

name: Premiere Pro
summaryEn: inspect projects and automate media, sequences, timeline edits, audio, and exports
summaryZh: 检查项目，并自动化媒体、Sequence、时间线剪辑、音频与导出
tasksEn: inventory media and sequence settings
assemble one bounded edit without changing source files
validate missing media, timing, audio, and preview export
tasksZh: 盘点媒体与 Sequence 设置
在不修改源文件的情况下完成一个剪辑段落
验证丢失媒体、时序、音频与预览导出

name: RenderDoc
summaryEn: inspect graphics captures and automate replay, event, resource, and draw-call analysis
summaryZh: 检查图形捕获，并自动化回放、事件、资源与 Draw Call 分析
tasksEn: open a capture and identify the target frame
inspect events, resources, and pipeline state
report reproducible evidence without changing the source build
tasksZh: 打开捕获并定位目标帧
检查事件、资源与管线状态
在不修改源构建的情况下报告可复现证据

name: Shōgun
summaryEn: use 48 typed official-SDK tools to inspect motion-capture scenes, attributes, bounded channel data, optical cameras, and files, control timeline state, and run capability-gated processing
summaryZh: 通过 48 个基于官方 SDK 的类型化工具检查动捕场景、属性、有界 Channel 数据、光学相机与文件，控制时间线状态，并执行带能力门控的处理
tasksEn: inspect subjects, markers, skeletons, trajectories, hierarchy, transforms, attribute and channel names, bounded samples and gaps, optical cameras, and selection
inspect or change explicit play and animation ranges, key-derived selections, and playback when the host exposes Timeline
inspect or update an allowlisted processing setting and run ROM labeling, calibration, QuickPost, or another bounded processing step only after the host confirms the official capability
tasksZh: 检查角色、Marker、骨架、轨迹、层级、变换、属性与 Channel 名称、有界样本与缺口、光学相机和选择集
在宿主公开 Timeline 能力时检查或修改明确的播放/动画范围、由关键帧生成的选择集与播放状态
仅在宿主确认官方能力后检查或更新白名单内的处理设置，并执行 ROM 标记、校准、QuickPost 或其他有界处理

name: SketchUp
summaryEn: inspect live models and automate typed geometry, materials, Tags, scenes, validation, saves, and interchange
summaryZh: 检查在线模型，并自动化类型化几何体、材质、标签、场景、验证、保存与格式交换
tasksEn: inspect model entities, bounds, materials, Tags, and scenes
create grouped boxes or cylinders and assign typed material and organization metadata
validate persistent entities, save the SKP model, and export supported interchange
tasksZh: 检查模型实体、边界、材质、标签与场景
创建成组的盒体或圆柱体，并分配类型化材质与组织元数据
验证持久化实体、保存 SKP 模型并导出受支持的交换格式

name: TouchDesigner
summaryEn: inspect and automate operator networks, parameters, TOP capture, and project saves on the host main thread
summaryZh: 在宿主主线程中检查并自动化算子网络、参数、TOP 捕获与工程保存
tasksEn: inspect project state, operator paths, families, and parameters
create and connect typed operators, then set and read back bounded parameters
capture a TOP to PNG, save a TOE project, and verify returned size and hash metadata
tasksZh: 检查工程状态、算子路径、家族与参数
创建并连接类型化算子，再设置并回读范围明确的参数
将 TOP 捕获为 PNG、保存 TOE 工程并验证返回的大小与哈希元数据

name: Substance 3D Designer
summaryEn: inspect and automate procedural material graphs, parameters, dependencies, and outputs
summaryZh: 检查并自动化程序化材质图、参数、依赖与输出
tasksEn: inspect graph nodes, packages, and dependencies
build one editable material variation
validate exposed parameters and rendered outputs
tasksZh: 检查图节点、Package 与依赖
构建一个可编辑材质变体
验证公开参数与渲染输出

name: Substance 3D Painter
summaryEn: inspect projects and automate texture sets, layers, masks, materials, baking, and export
summaryZh: 检查项目，并自动化纹理集、图层、蒙版、材质、烘焙与导出
tasksEn: inspect texture sets and layer stacks
apply a reversible material or mask change
validate mesh maps and exported texture channels
tasksZh: 检查纹理集与图层栈
完成一次可撤销材质或蒙版修改
验证 Mesh Map 与导出纹理通道

name: Tiled
summaryEn: inspect and automate tile maps, layers, tilesets, objects, properties, and exports
summaryZh: 检查并自动化瓦片地图、图层、Tileset、对象、属性与导出
tasksEn: inspect map size, layers, and tilesets
author one bounded map or object-layer change
validate references, properties, and exported data
tasksZh: 检查地图尺寸、图层与 Tileset
完成一次范围明确的地图或对象层修改
验证引用、属性与导出数据

name: Unity
summaryEn: inspect projects and automate scenes, GameObjects, components, assets, tests, and builds
summaryZh: 检查项目，并自动化场景、GameObject、组件、资产、测试与构建
tasksEn: inventory scenes, assets, and project settings
build one small playable interaction
enter Play Mode and verify behavior before a build
tasksZh: 盘点场景、资产与项目设置
构建一个小型可玩交互
进入 Play Mode 并在构建前验证行为
vendorCaseEn: For Unity and Tuanjie AI projects, the [`unity-tuanjie-ai` Skill](https://github.com/dcc-mcp/dcc-mcp-unity/blob/main/src/dcc_mcp_unity/skills/unity-tuanjie-ai/SKILL.md) inspects the native Codely CustomTool catalog and only executes a tool from a fresh inspection result. Tuanjie owns sign-in, credits, downloads, and task recovery; DCC-MCP owns typed discovery, routing, and verification around those vendor capabilities.
vendorCaseZh: 对于 Unity 与团结 AI（Tuanjie AI）项目，[`unity-tuanjie-ai` Skill](https://github.com/dcc-mcp/dcc-mcp-unity/blob/main/src/dcc_mcp_unity/skills/unity-tuanjie-ai/SKILL.md) 会先检查原生 Codely CustomTool 目录，并且只执行本次检查返回的工具。登录、积分、下载与任务恢复由团结软件包负责；DCC-MCP 负责厂商能力外的类型化发现、路由与验证。

name: Unreal Engine
summaryEn: inspect projects and automate levels, actors, assets, Blueprints, tests, and packaged builds
summaryZh: 检查项目，并自动化关卡、Actor、资产、Blueprint、测试与打包构建
tasksEn: inventory maps, actors, assets, and project settings
build one bounded gameplay or editor workflow
run and verify the result before packaging
tasksZh: 盘点地图、Actor、资产与项目设置
构建一个范围明确的玩法或编辑器流程
在打包前运行并验证结果

name: Wwise
summaryEn: inspect Wwise projects and automate audio objects, Events, routing, SoundBanks, and audition
summaryZh: 检查 Wwise 项目，并自动化音频对象、Event、路由、SoundBank 与试听
tasksEn: inspect project hierarchy and audio objects
import and organize a bounded set of sounds
create Events and verify them through audition
tasksZh: 检查项目层级与音频对象
导入并整理范围明确的一组音频
创建 Event 并通过试听验证

name: LiquiGen
summaryEn: inspect LiquiGen node graphs, run bounded simulation controls, and validate VAT export for Unreal Engine
summaryZh: 检查 LiquiGen 节点图，执行有界模拟控制，并验证面向 Unreal Engine 的 VAT 导出
tasksEn: inspect the current node graph and simulation settings
run one bounded simulation or graph operation
export and validate VAT assets before Unreal Engine handoff
tasksZh: 检查当前节点图与模拟设置
执行一次范围明确的模拟或图操作
在交给 Unreal Engine 前导出并验证 VAT 资产
availabilityEn: LiquiGen is available as the `liquigen` route in the DCC-MCP Core 0.20.25 release catalog. Installation and host requirements remain in the adapter repository.
availabilityZh: LiquiGen 已作为 `liquigen` 路由进入 DCC-MCP Core 0.20.25 发布目录。安装方式与宿主要求以适配器仓库为准。

name: OBS Studio
summaryEn: inspect exact-process OBS scenes and sources and control recording through typed operations
summaryZh: 检查精确进程绑定的 OBS 场景与来源，并通过类型化操作控制录制
tasksEn: inspect the bound OBS process, active scene, and sources
start or stop a recording through typed controls
verify recording state and the resulting output
tasksZh: 检查绑定的 OBS 进程、当前场景与来源
通过类型化控制开始或停止录制
验证录制状态与生成的输出
availabilityEn: OBS Studio is available as the `obs` route in the DCC-MCP Core 0.20.25 release catalog. Installing the adapter does not install OBS Studio itself; follow the adapter's installation guide and verify a live instance.
availabilityZh: OBS Studio 已作为 `obs` 路由进入 DCC-MCP Core 0.20.25 发布目录。安装适配器不会安装 OBS Studio 本体；请按适配器安装说明配置，并验证在线实例。

name: Microsoft Office
summaryEn: inspect shared Office runtime capabilities and route supported document work to the owning application adapter
summaryZh: 检查 Office 共享运行时能力，并将受支持的文档工作路由到对应应用适配器
tasksEn: inspect the registered Office runtime and supported application routes
prepare one bounded document operation through the owning adapter
verify the saved document or rendered output in the target application
tasksZh: 检查已注册的 Office 运行时与受支持应用路由
通过对应适配器准备一次范围明确的文档操作
在目标应用中验证保存的文档或渲染结果
availabilityEn: The shared Office runtime is available as the `office` route in the DCC-MCP Core 0.20.25 release catalog. Application-specific support remains explicit; use the owning PowerPoint, Word, Excel, or Outlook repository for its current status.
availabilityZh: Office 共享运行时已作为 `office` 路由进入 DCC-MCP Core 0.20.25 发布目录。各应用支持状态仍需分别确认；请以 PowerPoint、Word、Excel 或 Outlook 对应仓库为准。

name: SpeedTree
summaryEn: discover a licensed SpeedTree instance and use only capabilities exposed by its approved official command hook
summaryZh: 发现已授权的 SpeedTree 实例，并且只使用经批准的官方命令 Hook 所公开的能力
tasksEn: bind the exact SpeedTree process and window before discovery
inspect the official capability catalog without guessing private APIs
export through an approved official path and validate downstream engine assets
tasksZh: 在发现能力前绑定精确的 SpeedTree 进程与窗口
检查官方能力目录，不猜测私有 API
通过获准的官方路径导出，并验证下游引擎资产
availabilityEn: Source preview. The public adapter repository has merged its first implementation, but it has no tag or GitHub Release and is not in the DCC-MCP Core 0.20.25 release catalog. One real SpeedTree Modeler 10.1 to Unreal Engine 5.5.4 ST9 handoff verified three LODs, corrected material/UV bindings, and a 1,234.383705 cm mesh height; collision scale and dynamic wind remain unverified.
availabilityZh: 源码预览。公开适配器仓库已经合并首个实现，但尚无 tag 或 GitHub Release，也未进入 DCC-MCP Core 0.20.25 发布目录。一次真实 SpeedTree Modeler 10.1 到 Unreal Engine 5.5.4 的 ST9 交接验证了 3 个 LOD、修正后的材质/UV 绑定与 1,234.383705 cm 网格高度；碰撞比例与动态风仍未验收。

name: Epic Games Launcher and Fab
summaryEn: inspect installed Unreal Engine builds and Fab inventory, then plan bounded verified engine, asset, and project operations
summaryZh: 检查已安装的 Unreal Engine 与 Fab 资产清单，并规划有界、可验证的引擎、资产与项目操作
tasksEn: inspect installed Unreal Engine manifests, projects, and local Fab inventory
prepare one read-before-write engine or free-asset operation through an approved provider
verify ownership, downloaded bytes, and Unreal project import evidence
tasksZh: 检查已安装的 Unreal Engine 清单、项目与本地 Fab 资产库
通过已批准的提供方准备一次先读后写的引擎或免费资产操作
验证资产所有权、下载字节与 Unreal 项目导入证据
availabilityEn: Source preview. Version 0.2.0 exists on the repository's main branch, but the repository has no tag or GitHub Release and Epic is not a host route in the DCC-MCP Core 0.20.25 catalog. Engine installation remains plan-only without a verified native provider; login, CAPTCHA, purchases, and license acceptance stay human-owned.
availabilityZh: 源码预览。仓库 main 分支已有 0.2.0 源码，但没有 tag 或 GitHub Release，Epic 也不是 DCC-MCP Core 0.20.25 目录中的 Host 路由。缺少已验证原生提供方时，引擎安装仍只生成计划；登录、验证码、购买与许可接受继续由用户负责。

name: Gaea
summaryEn: inspect registered terrain templates, run bounded Build Swarm jobs, and verify heightmap and weightmap outputs
summaryZh: 检查已注册地形模板，运行有界 Build Swarm 任务，并验证高度图与权重图输出
tasksEn: inspect a registered terrain graph and its bounded numeric overrides
plan or run one configured Build Swarm job without overwriting outputs
verify exported image dimensions, hashes, and the declared Unreal handoff extent
tasksZh: 检查已注册地形图与有界数值覆写项
规划或运行一个不会覆盖输出的已配置 Build Swarm 任务
验证导出图像尺寸、哈希与声明的 Unreal 交接范围
availabilityEn: Source preview. The initial 0.1.0 implementation has no tag or GitHub Release and is not in the DCC-MCP Core 0.20.25 catalog. Real licensed Gaea builds, process-tree cancellation, terrain quality, and Unreal imports remain unverified.
availabilityZh: 源码预览。首个 0.1.0 实现没有 tag 或 GitHub Release，也未进入 DCC-MCP Core 0.20.25 目录。真实授权 Gaea 构建、进程树取消、地形质量与 Unreal 导入仍未验收。

name: Marvelous Designer
summaryEn: inspect garment patterns and run bounded project, pattern, simulation, save, and export operations through the documented Python API
summaryZh: 通过官方 Python API 检查服装纸样，并执行有界的项目、纸样、模拟、保存与导出操作
tasksEn: inspect API availability and paginated pattern information
create a bounded rectangular pattern or run a limited synchronous simulation
save a new ZPRJ or verify OBJ, FBX, or Alembic artifacts in an empty output directory
tasksZh: 检查 API 可用性与分页纸样信息
创建一个有界矩形纸样或运行有限步同步模拟
保存新的 ZPRJ，或在空输出目录中验证 OBJ、FBX、Alembic 产物
availabilityEn: Source preview. The initial 0.1.0 implementation has no tag or GitHub Release and is not in the DCC-MCP Core 0.20.25 catalog. No licensed Marvelous Designer host, Qt bootstrap, cloth simulation, or engine handoff has completed acceptance.
availabilityZh: 源码预览。首个 0.1.0 实现没有 tag 或 GitHub Release，也未进入 DCC-MCP Core 0.20.25 目录。真实授权 Marvelous Designer Host、Qt 启动、布料模拟与引擎交接均未完成验收。

name: OpenScreen
summaryEn: inspect recording sources and run typed bounded record and export operations without desktop UI automation
summaryZh: 检查录制来源，并在不使用桌面 UI 自动化的前提下执行类型化、有界的录制与导出操作
tasksEn: inspect available OpenScreen recording sources
start one bounded recording through the configured executable
export and verify the requested recording artifact
tasksZh: 检查可用的 OpenScreen 录制来源
通过已配置可执行文件启动一次有界录制
导出并验证请求的录制产物
availabilityEn: Source preview. The 0.1.0 repository has no tag or GitHub Release and is not in the DCC-MCP Core 0.20.25 catalog. Source tests do not establish live Windows recording acceptance; unsupported window selection remains owned by dcc-cua and ui-control.
availabilityZh: 源码预览。0.1.0 仓库没有 tag 或 GitHub Release，也未进入 DCC-MCP Core 0.20.25 目录。源码测试不能替代真实 Windows 录制验收；未支持的窗口选择仍由 dcc-cua 与 ui-control 负责。

name: Tracy Profiler
summaryEn: capture instrumented processes with Tracy and export bounded offline zone data for performance analysis
summaryZh: 使用 Tracy 捕获已插桩进程，并导出有界离线 Zone 数据用于性能分析
tasksEn: verify the target is instrumented and the official Tracy utilities are available
capture one bounded trace from the declared client address
export CSV data and summarize high-variance profiling zones
tasksZh: 验证目标已接入 Tracy 插桩且官方工具可用
从声明的客户端地址捕获一次有界 Trace
导出 CSV 并汇总波动较大的性能 Zone
catalogStatusEn: Independent adapter release v0.2.5; not a host route in the Core 0.20.25 catalog.
catalogStatusZh: 独立适配器已发布 v0.2.5；不是 Core 0.20.25 目录中的 Host 路由。
availabilityEn: Tracy adapter v0.2.5 is independently released, but it is not a host route in the DCC-MCP Core 0.20.25 catalog. The target must already contain Tracy instrumentation. The adapter controls official capture/export utilities and does not inject profiling into an uninstrumented process.
availabilityZh: Tracy 适配器已独立发布 v0.2.5，但不是 DCC-MCP Core 0.20.25 目录中的 Host 路由。目标必须已经接入 Tracy 插桩；适配器只控制官方捕获与导出工具，不会向未插桩进程注入分析能力。

name: ZBrush
summaryEn: inspect documents and automate tools, subtools, sculpting operations, remeshing, and export
summaryZh: 检查文档，并自动化 Tool、SubTool、雕刻操作、重拓扑与导出
tasksEn: inspect active tools, subtools, and mesh state
perform one bounded sculpting or remesh operation
validate topology, subdivision state, and exported geometry
tasksZh: 检查当前 Tool、SubTool 与网格状态
完成一次范围明确的雕刻或重拓扑操作
验证拓扑、细分状态与导出几何体
